# Law Enforcement Therapy Canine Oliver Appreciation Day – 2024

April 30th is officially “Law Enforcement Therapy Canine Oliver Appreciation Day” in Hamilton County!! We are proud to present this proclamation on behalf of Sheriff Charmaine McGuffey and the Hamilton County Board of Commissioners.

Thank you to Major Laetitia Schuler, Sergeant Ryan Cornett, Wellness Coordinator Ali Hoevel, and our wonderful Oliver for all the work they do to ensure that we have adequate resources and support in the form of Oliver’s therapeutic offerings and the Wellness Program as a whole.

Give Oliver some snuggles when you see him!
